red_baseline.finding: supervised-capture.js verified a real MP4 + sidecar with ZERO errors, and the upstream audit still reported REAL_PRESENTER_AUDIO_MISSING. A verified human recording existed and the production system had no way to know it was a presenter take.
red_baseline.cause: no producer connected the two; supervised-capture.js deliberately does not touch package-run state, and presenter-take-manifest.js had no caller

four_distinct_acts.verification: supervised-capture.js — are these bytes a valid recording?
four_distinct_acts.registration: scripts/supervised-presenter-take-adapter.js (THIS mission) — is this recording a take of this unit, in this run?
four_distinct_acts.note: the adapter performs exactly one of these

adapter.deterministic: no model call, no judgement, no media generation
adapter.boundary_preserved: supervised-capture.js is unchanged and still never mutates lifecycle state

run_binding.problem: the capture sidecar carries no run_id, so nothing tied a recording to a run
run_binding.solution: the run declares its capture destination at preflight; a recording is bound to this run because it was written where this run said to write it
run_binding.rejected_alternative: teaching supervised-capture.js about package runs, which would break its boundary

sidecar_finding.detail: the sidecar records no media hash, so verifyCaptureFile cannot distinguish a mutated recording from an intact one — appending bytes to an MP4 leaves the file large enough, the sidecar consistent and ffprobe satisfied.
sidecar_finding.mitigation: the adapter hashes what it registers, so every later change is detectable and is reported as MEDIA_DRIFT, distinct from ALREADY_REGISTERED
sidecar_finding.residual: byte mutation between capture and FIRST registration is not detectable from the sidecar alone. Not a blocker (the capture tool is the trusted local producer) but recorded honestly.
sidecar_finding.not_a_stop_condition: provenance is otherwise sufficient: capture_id ↔ MP4 basename ↔ output_file ↔ metadata_file ↔ approval_boundary ↔ audio_mode, plus ffprobe streams

presenter_audio_authority.chosen: A — the audio stream of the registered take media
presenter_audio_authority.reason: the dialogue IS the audio stream; the take already carries has_audio and an exact hash, so no extraction and no second authority is created
presenter_audio_authority.silent_profile_refused_at_preflight: a presenter dialogue take requires an audio-bearing profile, and that is checked BEFORE Mikko performs rather than after

proven.registration: MEDIA_VALID take, manifest revision 1 -> 2, successor chain valid, manifest valid
proven.exact_binding: media sha256 + byte_size + duration + has_video + has_audio + capture_binding_sha256 + sidecar sha256
proven.multiple_takes: 3 distinct recordings -> 3 takes, 3 distinct hashes, 0 selections, 0 recommendations

proxy_guard_note: the upstream audit checks take.origin / take.proxy, but the take schema is a strict object with no such fields — on a schema-valid manifest that check can never fire. The refusal therefore happens in the adapter, before anything is written.

selection_authority.select: a verified human via createHumanSelection; verifierValid refuses type AGENT and refuses any agent id posing as HUMAN
proven_refusals: HUMAN with an agent id -> refused
selection_authority.after_a_genuine_human_selection: the Editor handoff is still not ready: blockers were CURRENT_STORY_REQUIRED, PREVIEW_ONLY, TRANSCRIPT_OR_HUMAN_FIDELITY_REQUIRED, FIDELITY_UNRESOLVED. Registration is not the end of the presenter lane.

leniency_observation: the program-mix audit clears presenter on a registered take alone, while the presenter manifest itself does not consider that take editor-ready until a transcript and fidelity record exist. The two thresholds differ; recorded, not changed.

enablement_prerequisites: canonical presenter take/delivery artifact contract proven end to end
Editor take-selection boundary demonstrated against real evidence
explicit human enablement decision by Mikko
presenter_director.prerequisite_progress: this mission addresses "canonical presenter take/delivery artifact contract proven end to end" and demonstrates the Editor take-selection boundary; the explicit human enablement decision by Mikko remains outstanding and was not taken

production_operations.role_here: gate-7 PRODUCTION preparation_owner; orchestrates the capture session
production_operations.semantic_take_ownership: NOT assigned to it — orchestrating a capture is not owning the performance

gate7.note: unchanged by this mission; the adapter never advances a gate

gate8.note: real human capture evidence still required; no proxy disposition, no synthetic marker, no automatic approval

gates.real_capture_predicate: a registered supervised take row passes; proxy and synthetic rows still fail

human_boundary: the machine says: record the real presenter performance. Nothing earlier is outstanding, and no later software blocker is hiding behind that action within the capture lane.

music_requiredness_finding.detail: production-mix-upstream-readiness hardcodes music as required while the proven attester accepts presenter-only program audio, so a legitimate no-music Short can be reported MUSIC_RUN_BINDING_MISSING.
music_requiredness_finding.correct_future_rule: derive music requiredness from the canonical edit/timeline AUDIO_MUSIC track declaration

remaining_production_gap: a real presenter performance does not exist. Everything a machine can do before it is done.
